id.description:
ID is the stable identifier in the form "<module>:<role>"; this is what member and
invitation requests carry in their roles.

module.description: Module is the module that declared the role, e.g. "fin".

name.description: Name is the human readable display name, e.g. "Accountant".

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

get.description: Handle authorization code callback from OAuth provider and establish session
Retrieve authenticated session and user details

post.description: Initiate OAuth2 social login (Google, GitHub) and get authorization URL
Revoke current session from database and clear session cookie
